description: A user's home Wi-Fi is slow and dropping intermittently. They need to go through a standard diagnostic process: checking the router, ISP status, and device interference.

user_profile.context: Important video call in 30 minutes, internet is acting up

fact_sheet.fact: The user's name is Alex Chen.
Alex Chen is 29 years old and works from home as a Project Manager for Innovate Inc.
Alex Chen has a critical project kickoff video call scheduled for 11:00 AM on October 26, 2023.
The video call is with a major client, Globex Corp, and will be hosted on Zoom.
The Zoom Meeting ID for the Globex Corp call is 852 1199 0456.
The internet connectivity issues began at approximately 9:45 AM on October 26, 2023.
The primary symptom is intermittent connection drops, where the internet is unavailable for 10-30 seconds at a time.
A speed test run at 10:15 AM showed a download speed of 12.5 Mbps and an upload speed of 3.1 Mbps.
A command-line ping to dns.google (8.8.8.8) at 10:16 AM showed an average latency of 450 ms with 25% packet loss.
The 'Internet' status light on the Wi-Fi router is blinking amber, whereas the manual indicates it should be solid green for a stable connection.
The connectivity issue is affecting all devices on the network, including a laptop connected directly via an Ethernet cable.
The Internet Service Provider is 'AetherNet Solutions'.
The internet plan is the 'FiberStream 500', with advertised speeds of 500 Mbps download and 100 Mbps upload.
Alex Chen's AetherNet Solutions account number is AE-774-9012-B.
The 24/7 technical support phone number for AetherNet Solutions is 1-888-555-0123.
The AetherNet Solutions network status webpage is located at status.aether.net.
The Wi-Fi router is a QuantumLink model QL-7500.
The router's current firmware version is 2.1.34_build20230815.
The Wi-Fi network SSID is 'QuantumLink_AC_5G'.
The router is physically located on a wooden bookshelf in the living room, 3 feet from the floor.
The router's administration panel is accessible at the IP address http://192.168.1.1.
The last configuration change to the router was made on September 1, 2023, to update the Wi-Fi password.
Alex's work laptop, a 'StellarBook Pro' with serial number SN789XYZ, is connected to the network.
The StellarBook Pro's Wi-Fi MAC address is 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E.
A 'VividView 4K' smart TV in the living room is attempting to stream a video service.
An 'EchoSphere' smart speaker is connected to the network in the kitchen.
Alex's personal smartphone, a 'Pixelate 8', is also connected to the Wi-Fi.
A new 'SmartFlow' brand microwave oven, model SF-200X, was installed yesterday and is located 10 feet from the router.
There are a total of 7 devices currently attempting to connect to the network.
At 10:20 AM, Alex performed a power cycle on the QuantumLink QL-7500 router by unplugging it for 60 seconds.
At 10:22 AM, Alex checked the AetherNet Solutions status page, which reported 'All Systems Operational' for his zip code, 98101.
Alex disconnected his Pixelate 8 smartphone from the Wi-Fi at 10:25 AM to reduce network load, but this action resulted in no improvement.
Alex Chen's service address is 456 Tech Vista Lane, Apt 3B, Seattle, WA 98101.
Alex needs to present a 1.2 GB PowerPoint file during the 11:00 AM meeting.

user_needs.description: What are the specific symptoms of my internet problem and when did they start?
What were the results of the speed and ping tests I ran?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After describing the symptoms, a user would naturally want to see the quantitative data that confirms the problem's severity.

user_needs.description: What is the status light on my Wi-Fi router showing?
What did the ISP's network status page say when I checked it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After seeing a router error light, a user's next logical step is to determine if the fault is local or with the provider by checking for a reported outage.

user_needs.description: What are my plan's advertised speeds compared to the speeds I'm actually getting?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After confirming there's no official outage, the user will want to compare their current poor performance against the service level they pay for.

user_needs.description: What is the technical support phone number for my ISP, AetherNet Solutions?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user confirms via the status page that there is no widespread outage, the immediate next step is to contact support directly. This is an auditable proactive target.

user_needs.description: Is the connection problem affecting all devices, including my wired computer?
Were any new appliances recently installed near the router?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning the issue affects the entire network (wired and wireless), a user might consider environmental factors. This auditable proactive target suggests a potential source of interference.

user_needs.description: What is the Zoom Meeting ID for my important 11:00 AM call?
How large is the presentation file I need for this meeting?
